Article says the Genesis Mission project will unite national laboratories, industry, and academia.
Article says the manifesto proposes shifting support toward individual researchers and private companies, but the Genesis Mission funding unites national labs, industry, and academia.
Article notes a proposal suggesting radically reducing government support for life sciences.
Article states the plan increases support for foundational research in the biological sciences.
Article says neither the report nor the White House defines those terms or explains which fields would gain or lose funding.
